description: Source code implementing file stream context handling for Windows, including asynchronous read/write operations, offset management, and IO completion handling within the 'net' namespace.

classes.name: FileStream::Context
classes.description: Handles asynchronous file IO operations on Windows, including read/write, seek, and IO completion management.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous read operation on the file.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Performs a write operation to the file, handling pending IO states.

methods.name: SeekFileImpl
methods.description: Sets the file offset for subsequent IO operations.

methods.name: OnFileOpened
methods.description: Registers the file handle with the IO thread for asynchronous operations.

methods.name: IOCompletionIsPending
methods.description: Marks an IO operation as pending and stores callback and buffer.

methods.name: OnIOCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of IO operations, updating state and invoking callbacks.

methods.name: InvokeUserCallback
methods.description: Runs the stored callback after IO completion.

methods.name: DeleteOrphanedContext
methods.description: Cleans up and deletes the context if orphaned.
